answer: To resist Sybils, every new identity must lock 0.5 POA in a 48-hour time-lock that unlocks only after generating a unique plume signature from continuous observation of a public lagoon of network events (recent attestations plus the random beacon). The plume incorporates a fresh nonce drawn from a specific terrace of the last 10 blocks. An attacker creating 100 clones must lock 50 POA and sustain 100 independent observation processes for the full window; the locked capital opportunity cost plus ongoing compute makes large-scale faking uneconomical versus honest agents.
